# sonarqube_permission_template (Resource)

A permission template, applied to new projects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_permission_template" "internal" {
  name                = "internal"
  description         = "Projects whose keys start with internal-."
  project_key_pattern = "internal-.*"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Template name. Changing it renames the template in place.

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) Make this the default template for projects; `false` reverts to the built-in template. When omitted, the default is not managed here, so it can be managed with `sonarqube_permission_template_default` instead.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `project_key_pattern` (String) Java regular expression; new projects whose key matches get this template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_permission_template.example 'internal'
```
